tool.name: DoubletFinder
tool.description: Doublet detection in single-cell RNA-seq data using artificial nearest neighbors
tool.command: Rscript '$__tool_directory__/doubletfinder.R' --input-object '$input_object' --output-object '$output_object' --output-table '$output_table' --output-sweep '$output_sweep' #if $save_plot: --output-plot '$output_plot' #end if --pcs $pcs --pn $pn --pk-mode '$pk_mode.pk_mode' #if $pk_mode.pk_mode == 'manual': --pk $pk_mode.pk #if $pk_mode.reuse_pann: --reuse-pann '$pk_mode.reuse_pann' #end if #end if --nexp-mode '$nexp_mode.nexp_mode' #if $nexp_mode.nexp_mode == 'expected_rate': --doublet-rate $nexp_mode.doublet_rate #if $nexp_mode.adjust_homotypic: --homotypic-adjust --annotation-col '$nexp_mode.annotation_col' #end if #else: --nexp $nexp_mode.nexp #end if #if $sct: --sct #end if #if $save_sweep_table: --save-sweep-table #end if #if $save_plot: --save-plot #end if #if $seed: --seed $seed #end if

param.name: input_object
param.label: Seurat object
param.help: A fully pre-processed Seurat object (after NormalizeData, FindVariableFeatures, ScaleData and RunPCA), saved as RDS or RData.

param.name: pcs
param.label: Number of PCs
param.help: Number of statistically significant principal components to use, as estimated e.g. from a PC elbow plot.

param.name: pn
param.label: Artificial doublet proportion (pN)
param.help: Proportion of artificial doublets, expressed as a proportion of the merged real-artificial data. Performance is largely pN-invariant; keep the default unless you have a reason to change it.

param.name: pk_mode
param.label: pK selection mode
param.option: Automatic (run parameter sweep and use the pK with maximum BCmvn)
Manual (supply pK directly, skip the sweep)

param.name: pk
param.label: PC neighborhood size (pK)
param.help: The PC neighborhood size used to compute pANN, expressed as a proportion of the merged real-artificial data.

param.name: reuse_pann
param.label: Existing pANN metadata column to reuse
param.help: Name of a 'pANN.*' column in the object's meta.data (e.g. from a previous DoubletFinder run) to reuse for re-classification. Leave empty for a fresh run.

param.name: doublet_rate
param.label: Expected doublet rate
param.help: Expected doublet rate, e.g. ~0.075 (7.5%) for ~10,000 cells loaded on a 10x Chromium (~0.8% per 1,000 cells). Adjust for your platform and loading density.

param.name: adjust_homotypic
param.label: Adjust for homotypic doublets
param.help: Estimate the proportion of homotypic doublets from cell-type annotations with modelHomotypic and reduce the expected doublet count accordingly.

param.name: annotation_col
param.label: Annotation meta.data column
param.help: Name of the meta.data column holding cell-type (cluster) annotations, used for the homotypic adjustment. e.g. 'seurat_clusters' or 'RNA_snn_res.0.5'.

validator.message: Column names must not contain whitespace

param.name: nexp
param.label: Expected number of doublets (nExp)
param.help: The total number of doublet predictions to produce.

param.name: sct
param.label: Object was normalized with SCTransform
param.help: Enable if the input Seurat object was pre-processed with SCTransform instead of NormalizeData.

param.name: save_sweep_table
param.label: Save the pK sweep statistics table
param.help: Outputs the mean-variance-normalized bimodality coefficient (BCmvn) table from the parameter sweep (automatic pK mode only).

param.name: save_plot
param.label: Save the BCmvn vs pK plot
param.help: Outputs a PNG plot of the BCmvn curve across the pK sweep, highlighting the selected pK (automatic pK mode only).

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed
param.help: Set for reproducible artificial doublet generation and pANN computation.

tool.help:
# DoubletFinder
**What it does**
DoubletFinder predicts doublets in single-cell RNA-seq data by artificially creating doublets from existing data, embedding them alongside real cells in PCA space, and computing the proportion of artificial nearest neighbors (pANN) for every real cell. pANN values are then thresholded according to the expected number of doublets to produce final doublet predictions.
This tool implements the standard DoubletFinder workflow:
1. `paramSweep` — generate artificial doublets and compute pANN across a pN-pK parameter grid (optional, in automatic pK mode) 2. `summarizeSweep` — summarize sweep results 3. `find.pK` — identify the pK with the maximum mean-variance-normalized bimodality coefficient (BCmvn) 4. `doubletFinder` — classify cells as singlets or doublets
**Input requirements**
Provide a *fully pre-processed* Seurat object (saved as RDS or RData): `NormalizeData`, `FindVariableFeatures`, `ScaleData` and `RunPCA` must already have been run. The input must originate from a single sample (see caveats).
**Parameters**
- **Number of PCs** — the number of statistically significant principal components, as estimated e.g. from a PC elbow plot. - **pN** — the artificial doublet proportion. Performance is largely pN-invariant; the default (0.25) is recommended. - **pK mode** — in *automatic* mode, the full parameter sweep is run and the pK with maximum BCmvn is used. In *manual* mode you supply pK directly (e.g. from the sweep table of a previous run) and may reuse an existing `pANN_*` metadata column for fast re-classification with a different expected doublet count. - **Expected doublets** — specify either a *rate* (e.g. ~0.8% per 1,000 cells on the 10x Chromium platform; ~7.5% for 10,000 cells loaded), which is multiplied by the cell count, or a direct *count*. With the rate mode you can optionally *adjust for homotypic doublets*: the proportion of doublets expected to form between cells of the same type (estimated from your cluster/annotation column via `modelHomotypic`) is subtracted, giving a lower bound on the detectable doublet rate. - **SCTransform** — enable if the object was pre-processed with SCTransform rather than NormalizeData.
**Outputs**
- **Annotated Seurat object** — the input object with added `pANN_*` and `DF.classifications_*` meta.data columns. - **Per-cell classification table** — barcode, pANN score and Singlet/Doublet call for every cell; useful for filtering downstream. - **pK sweep statistics** — the BCmvn table from `find.pK` (automatic mode). - **BCmvn plot** — BCmvn across the sweep, highlighting the selected pK.
**Important caveats**
- Do not run DoubletFinder on aggregated data from multiple *distinct* samples (e.g. different 10x lanes or different conditions); run it per-sample/per-lane instead. - Remove low-quality clusters before running. - DoubletFinder is insensitive to homotypic doublets (doublets formed by cells of the same type, which are transcriptionally indistinguishable from singlets). The homotypic-adjusted estimate 'bookends' the true detectable rate. - Artificial doublet generation and the parameter sweep are stochastic; set a random seed for reproducibility.
